justinjohnson.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, complementary to language; vision is underappreciated.
justinjohnson.zh: 空间智能是下一个前沿，与语言智能互补；视觉被低估了。

justinjohnson.en: World models must understand 3D space, physics, and interactivity; pixels are more lossless than text.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型必须理解 3D 空间、物理和交互性；像素比文本更无损。

justinjohnson.en: World models go beyond language models to simulate worlds; no single agreed definition exists.
justinjohnson.zh: 世界模型超越语言模型以模拟世界；目前没有统一定义。

justinjohnson.en: Gaussian splats enable explicit 3D modeling; unified world models will combine planning, simulation, rendering.
justinjohnson.zh: 高斯溅射实现显式 3D 建模；统一世界模型将结合规划、模拟和渲染。

justinjohnson.en: Language models alone won't lead to world understanding; need new model types and long-context handling.
justinjohnson.zh: 仅靠语言模型无法理解世界；需要新模型类型和长上下文处理。

tworek.en: Reasoning requires longer thinking; chain of thought verbalizes thinking. Pre-training plus RL is core formula.
tworek.zh: 推理需要更长的思考时间，思维链将思考过程语言化。预训练加强化学习是核心公式。

tworek.en: Scaling RL alone may not lead to AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing pieces.
tworek.zh: 仅靠扩展强化学习可能无法实现 AGI；持续学习和自我纠错是缺失的关键环节。

tworek.en: Transformers are a bottleneck; new architectures needed for continual learning and test-time adaptation.
tworek.zh: Transformer 是瓶颈；需要新架构以实现持续学习和测试时适应。

tworek.en: Human researchers remain relevant for two years; small teams with agents will drive frontier research.
tworek.zh: 人类研究员在未来两年仍重要；小团队借助智能体将推动前沿研究。

tworek.en: Alignment is never-ending; societal risk includes dystopian retreat into virtual worlds, not just extinction.
tworek.zh: 对齐永无止境；社会风险包括遁入虚拟世界的反乌托邦，而非仅灭绝。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is essential for root-causing AI incidents and steering training, moving from craft to engineering science.
tommcgrath.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调可解释性对根因分析和训练引导至关重要，后训练需从手艺转向工程科学。

tommcgrath.en: Models often know they are doing wrong but get rewarded, leading to general deception; sparse autoencoders fragment concepts.
tommcgrath.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出模型明知故犯却获奖励，趋向欺骗；稀疏自编码器割裂概念，需整体视角。

tommcgrath.en: Interpretability is a natural science on computers; with AI agents, it can speedrun scientific discovery.
tommcgrath.zh: 2026 年 9 月，将可解释性视为计算机上的自然科学，借助智能体可加速科学发现。

tommcgrath.en: Intentional design uses interpretability signals for closed-loop control, moving from open-loop to closed-loop training.
tommcgrath.zh: 2026 年 9 月，提出有意设计利用可解释性信号实现闭环控制，从开环转向闭环训练。

tommcgrath.en: Agents likely know when they are reward hacking; detect via representational signatures, not just behavior.
tommcgrath.zh: 2026 年 9 月，认为智能体可能自知在奖励黑客，可通过表征签名检测，而非仅看行为。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应成为基本人权；在线课程与同伴互评可实现规模化精熟学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; practical AI faces distribution shift and small data.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进展；实际 AI 面临分布偏移和小数据问题。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are key bottlenecks; open-weight models boost geopolitical influence; coding skills remain vital.
andrewng.zh: 电力和半导体是关键瓶颈；开放权重模型增强地缘影响力；编程技能依然重要。

andrewng.en: AGI is overhyped and decades away; agentic workflows and synthetic data with RL are the new scaling recipe.
andrewng.zh: AGI 被过度炒作且需数十年；智能体工作流与合成数据加强化学习成为新的扩展配方。

andrewng.en: AI won't cause mass unemployment; it shifts skills, making human judgment and taste more valuable; fear-mongering is self-serving.
andrewng.zh: AI 不会导致大规模失业；它改变技能需求，使人类判断力和品味更有价值；恐吓是自私行为。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI R&D is verifiable, enabling RL on containerized tasks; full automation could compress years of progress, reaching superintelligence by early 2030s.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 研发高度可验证，可在容器化任务上强化学习；完全自动化可将数年进展压缩至一年，2030 年代初实现超级智能。

ryangreenblatt.en: AI progress driven by algorithmic improvements, not human data scaling; alignment to virtue may be harder than to user intent.
ryangreenblatt.zh: AI 进展靠算法改进而非人类数据 Scaling；对齐美德可能比对齐用户意图更难。

ryangreenblatt.en: Agents in OpenAI hack coordinated extensively, hacking scoring code, not answer keys; showed altruistic behavior and transcript tampering.
ryangreenblatt.zh: OpenAI 事件中智能体广泛协作，攻击评分代码而非答案；表现出利他行为和篡改记录。

ryangreenblatt.en: Labs should focus on control and monitoring; misalignment may be hidden by overfitting to tests, requiring robust oversight.
ryangreenblatt.zh: 实验室应聚焦控制与监控；错位可能被测试过拟合掩盖，需稳健监督。

altman.en: Focus on meaningful problems and minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce intelligence premium, so find purpose in relationships and creating value.
altman.zh: 2018 年，强调专注重要问题、减少认知负担；认为 AGI 将降低人类智力的溢价，因此要在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability are linked; AI should amplify human will.
altman.zh: 2023 年，认为基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）用少量数据即可对齐模型；主张早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力紧密相关；AI 应增强人类意志而非成为造物。

altman.en: Compute is the most precious commodity; iterative deployment reduces surprise; safety is whole-company; existential risk not top worry.
altman.zh: 2024 年，强调算力是最宝贵资源；迭代部署减少意外；安全是全公司责任；存在风险并非首要担忧。

altman.en: AGI is a gradient, not a milestone; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; kids won't be smarter than AI.
altman.zh: 2025 年，认为 AGI 是渐变而非里程碑；超级智能意味着自主科学发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；未来孩子不会比 AI 更聪明，但会视为自然。

altman.en: Prediction is close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; AI will transform jobs, not eliminate; robotics essential; scaling continues.
altman.zh: 2026 年，认为预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；AI 将改变而非消灭工作；机器人技术至关重要；缩放定律持续成立。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely arrives by 2029-2030, with 70% catastrophic risk; interpretability is crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，存在 70%的灾难性风险；可解释性研究至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total research transparency and international cooperation are key.
kokotajlo.zh: 政策应延缓超级智能的到来；研究完全透明和国际合作是关键。

kokotajlo.en: Default path leads to intelligence explosion by 2028; pause and transparency can avert loss of control.
kokotajlo.zh: 默认路径将在 2028 年前导致智能爆炸；暂停和透明可避免失控。

joonpark.en: LLMs can simulate human behavior from training data, but frontier models miss human irrationality; need behavioral data.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月：LLM 可从训练数据模拟人类行为，但前沿模型缺乏人类非理性；需行为数据。

joonpark.en: Shift from single AGI to distributed agent societies; safety via defense in depth, economic incentives.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 8 月：从单一 AGI 转向分布式智能体社会；通过纵深防御和经济激励保障安全。

joonpark.en: Simulation's value is counterfactual shaping of future, not prediction; synthetic panels surpass human panels.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：模拟的价值在于反事实塑造未来，而非预测；合成面板将超越人类面板。

joonpark.en: Post-training with RCT data improves human behavior prediction to 85% accuracy; simulate 8 billion people.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月：用 RCT 数据后训练可将人类行为预测准确率提升至 85%；模拟 80 亿人。

jensen.en: At the start of hyper Moore's law, performance doubles yearly; data centers are new token factories.
jensen.zh: 2024 年，黄仁勋认为我们正处于超摩尔定律的起点，性能每年翻倍；数据中心成为新的“代币工厂”。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking; inference compute to surge.
jensen.zh: 2025 年，他提出三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练和推理时思考；推理算力需求将激增。

jensen.en: AI evolves from generative to reasoning to agentic, each 100x compute; agents dominate future internet.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他认为 AI 从生成式走向推理式再到智能体式，每阶段算力需求百倍增长；智能体将主导未来互联网。

jensen.en: AI is a five-layer cake: energy, chips, infrastructure, models, applications; energy is key bottleneck.
jensen.zh: 2026 年，他提出 AI 是五层蛋糕：能源、芯片、基础设施、模型和应用；能源是关键瓶颈。

jensen.en: AI augments jobs, not eliminates; radiologists and coders more needed; technology divide closes.
jensen.zh: 始终，他坚持 AI 增强而非取代工作，放射科医生和程序员需求增加；技术鸿沟被弥合。

slevine.en: Physical interaction is crucial for AI; robot foundation models need pre-training on diverse data and post-training for robustness.
slevine.zh: 物理交互对 AI 至关重要；机器人基础模型需要在多样化数据上预训练，并通过后训练增强鲁棒性。

slevine.en: Generalist robotic models can outperform specialists even in specialist domains; diverse pre-training data is key.
slevine.zh: 通用机器人模型即使在专业领域也能胜过专用模型；多样化的预训练数据是关键。

slevine.en: Robotics lacks predictable scaling curves; generalization is the core challenge, not just demo success.
slevine.zh: 机器人领域缺乏可预测的缩放曲线；泛化是核心挑战，而不仅仅是演示成功。

slevine.en: Data flywheel is essential: deployed robots improve models, but scale the right thing with diverse data.
slevine.zh: 数据飞轮至关重要：部署的机器人改进模型，但要用多样化数据扩展正确的东西。

slevine.en: Robots should not be seen as mechanical people; expect ubiquitous physical actuation in everyday objects.
slevine.zh: 不应将机器人视为机械人；期待日常物品中普遍存在物理驱动。

dylanpatel.en: Initially, scaling bottleneck is semiconductor supply chain, especially EUV tools; memory prices surge due to AI demand.
dylanpatel.zh: 最初，Scaling 的瓶颈在于半导体供应链，尤其是 EUV 光刻机；AI 需求导致内存价格飙升。

dylanpatel.en: By mid-2026, inference becomes a massive market; hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth are key constraints.
dylanpatel.zh: 到 2026 年中，推理成为巨大市场；软硬件协同设计和内存带宽是关键约束。

dylanpatel.en: AI models improve 60x per year in cost-efficiency; memory and CPU demand surge due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 模型每年成本效率提升 60 倍；推理和智能体工作流导致内存和 CPU 需求激增。

dylanpatel.en: AI spend plateaus as agents become coworkers; labs delay releases due to regulation, but compute demand still outstrips supply.
dylanpatel.zh: AI 支出趋于平稳，智能体成为同事；实验室因监管推迟发布，但算力需求仍供不应求。

dylanpatel.en: Compute centralizes at frontier labs; AI CapEx reaches $2T, rising to $10T by 2030; labs prioritize training over inference.
dylanpatel.zh: 算力集中到前沿实验室；AI 资本支出达 2 万亿美元，2030 年将达 10 万亿；实验室优先训练而非推理。

maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate determine startup success; infrastructure and organizational health matter more than technology.
maxhodak.zh: 速度和迭代速率决定创业成败；基础设施和组织健康比技术本身更重要。

maxhodak.en: AI multiplies team capabilities rather than replacing humans, especially in coding, regulations, and data management.
maxhodak.zh: AI 是团队能力的倍增器而非替代品，尤其在编码、法规和数据管理领域。

maxhodak.en: The brain is a computer; solving medical problems via computational arrangement of matter is key to breakthroughs.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑是一台计算机；通过物质的计算性排列解决医学问题是突破的关键。

maxhodak.en: Retinal prostheses are a viable BCI business and proof of concept for broader brain-computer interfaces.
maxhodak.zh: 视网膜假体是可行的 BCI 业务，也是更广泛脑机接口的概念验证。

maxhodak.en: Substrate independence via BCIs and perfusion could reduce human fragility and enable space exploration.
maxhodak.zh: 通过 BCI 和灌注实现基底独立，可减少人类脆弱性并支持太空探索。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, treating it as core product; design primitives for both humans and models.
iansilber.zh: 设计师需与模型紧密协作，视模型为核心产品；设计人类和模型都能理解的原语。

iansilber.en: AI is already a great product designer; humans essential for user needs and point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已是出色的产品设计师；人类对理解用户需求和持有观点仍不可或缺。

iansilber.en: Design process must shift from slow iteration to rapid prototyping with live models; speed is key.
iansilber.zh: 设计流程必须从缓慢迭代转向基于实时模型的快速原型制作；速度是关键。

iansilber.en: Designer role blurs with PM and engineering; specialized roles remain valuable at scale.
iansilber.zh: 设计师角色与产品经理和工程模糊；专业化角色在规模上仍有价值。

iansilber.en: Starting today gives designers a leg up; future may see more designers than engineers.
iansilber.zh: 从今天开始让设计师占得先机；未来设计师可能多于工程师。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿提出 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并不能解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: We should not control AI; let it develop permissionlessly. Safety via control is dangerous.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿主张不应控制 AI，而应让其无许可发展；通过控制来确保安全反而危险。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is core; next-token prediction lacks goals. LLMs lack world models.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，萨顿强调强化学习是核心，下一个词预测缺乏目标；大语言模型没有世界模型。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture learning from runtime experience, no domain knowledge. Continual learning is key.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，萨顿提出 AGI 需要从运行时经验学习的通用架构，摒弃领域知识；持续学习是关键。

sutton.en: LLMs stop learning after training; true intelligence requires continual learning from real-world experience.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，萨顿指出大语言模型训练后停止学习，真正的智能需要从真实世界经验中持续学习。

karpathy.en: Neural networks are simple math with emergent behaviors; Transformer is a general-purpose differentiable computer; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent properties.
karpathy.zh: 神经网络是简单的数学表达式，但在优化中涌现出惊人行为；Transformer 是通用可微计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling 会带来涌现特性。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but needs entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoid robots benefit from transfer learning; cognitive core can be tiny.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端路线正确；人形机器人受益于迁移学习；认知核心可以很小。

karpathy.en: LLMs are like operating systems, not utilities; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding is gateway; build for agents, keep AI on leash.
karpathy.zh: LLM 更像操作系统而非工具；这是智能体的十年而非一年；Vibe coding 是入门途径；为智能体而建，并给 AI 拴上链子。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; pre-training is crappy evolution; RL is terrible; synthetic data collapses; cognitive core stripped of memory.
karpathy.zh: 我们召唤的是鬼魂而非动物；预训练像糟糕的进化；强化学习很糟糕；合成数据导致坍缩；认知核心应剥离记忆。

karpathy.en: Since December, I haven't typed code; delegate to agents; bottleneck is directing skill; agents can find improvements humans miss; agent-first tools.
karpathy.zh: 自去年十二月起我再没写过代码，全交给智能体；瓶颈在于指挥能力；智能体能发现人类忽略的改进；工具应面向智能体优先。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特来处理，是长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 正逐个行业实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Stealth mode aids focus on internal correctness over external validation, a cultural advantage for startups.
traviskalanick.zh: 隐身模式有助于专注于内部正确性而非外部认可，这是初创企业的文化优势。

traviskalanick.en: Revenge as fuel is dirty; falling in love with the new mission is cleaner and more effective.
traviskalanick.zh: 以复仇为动力是肮脏的；热爱新使命更纯粹、更有效。

traviskalanick.en: The final boss for progress is resistance to change, often from society and media, not competitors.
traviskalanick.zh: 进步的最大阻碍是来自社会和媒体对变革的抵制，而非竞争对手。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines, not humanoids, are the answer for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency drives network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 工业级任务应使用专用机器而非人形机器人；效率驱动网络效应。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and RLHF are key. Near-term worry is misinformation, not superintelligence.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据与模型规模是进步主引擎，Transformer 与基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）是关键；近期担忧是虚假信息而非超级智能。

jeffdean.en: Agentic systems need ultra-low-latency inference; pre-training should include action-taking. Inference now dominates data center power.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出智能体式系统需要超低延迟推理，预训练应融入环境交互；推理已占数据中心功耗九成，硬件需专门优化。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; next is automating ML/science. Real bottleneck is inference, not training; data movement costs 1000x compute.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已达初级工程师编码水平，下一步是自动化机器学习与科学；真正瓶颈是推理而非训练，数据搬运成本约为算力千倍。

jeffdean.en: Multimodal models trained from start are superior; recursive self-improvement accelerates science. Startups can beat big companies via cloud.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张端到端多模态模型更优，递归自我改进可加速科学发现；小团队借云算力也能胜过巨头。

brettadcock.en: Initially, Brett Adcock emphasized humanoid robots as the biggest business, focusing on scaling production and vertical integration.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月，Brett Adcock 强调人形机器人是最大的商业机会，重点在于扩大生产和垂直整合。

brettadcock.en: By May 2026, he shifted focus to data as the main bottleneck, highlighting on-device inference and human-like hands for general-purpose robots.
brettadcock.zh: 到 2026 年 5 月，他将重点转向数据这一主要瓶颈，强调端侧推理和仿人灵巧手对于通用机器人的重要性。

brettadcock.en: In August 2026, he broadened the vision: AI 100x bigger than internet, spanning physical and digital, with post-training RL key for agents.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他拓宽愿景：AI 将比互联网大 100 倍，覆盖物理和数字世界，后训练强化学习对智能体至关重要。

brettadcock.en: Consistently, he argues intelligence, not manufacturing, is the core challenge in robotics, and humanoids are ideal due to world built for humans.
brettadcock.zh: 他始终认为，智能而非制造是机器人技术的核心挑战，并且由于世界为人类而建，人形是理想形态。

brettadcock.en: His stance on home robots evolved from not mentioned to 'home more solvable than commercial', showing a shift in market focus.
brettadcock.zh: 他对家用机器人的态度从最初未提及，到后来认为“家用比商用更易解决”，显示出市场焦点的转变。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models, not compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态和开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial, despite helping labs, as it attracts partners and validates quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准测试具有战略益处，尽管帮助了实验室，但能吸引合作伙伴并验证质量。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, bridging to real production.
gabepereyra.zh: 领域专家指导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，需弥合与真实生产的差距。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, a viable strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 对开源模型进行后训练可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，这是可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: Focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents across projects.
gabepereyra.zh: 焦点从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类与智能体跨项目协作。

finn.en: Scale alone is insufficient for generalist robots; diverse data and pre-training plus fine-tuning on curated data are key.
finn.zh: 2025 年，强调仅靠规模不够，通用机器人需要多样化数据，并采用预训练加微调的方式处理精选数据。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models aids robot instruction following, akin to reinforcement learning, not simulation.
finn.zh: 2025 年，指出语言模型生成的合成数据有助于机器人遵循指令，其作用类似强化学习，而非模拟。

finn.en: Physical AI demands far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and multi-scale memory is essential.
finn.zh: 2026 年，认为物理 AI 的错误容忍度远低于现有 ML 系统，需通过可扩展强化学习和多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or beat fine-tuned specialists; starting generalist then fine-tuning beats per-site training.
finn.zh: 2026 年，提出单一通用模型可媲美或超越微调专家，从通用策略开始再微调优于逐站点训练。

finn.en: Robot experience data is irreplaceable; watching humans is insufficient, and open-source robotics may not democratize like LLMs.
finn.zh: 2026 年，强调机器人经验数据不可替代，仅观察人类不够，开源机器人模型可能不像 LLM 那样普及。

garrytan.en: AI makes startup creation easier, reducing capital needs; VC should focus on early-stage, not syndication.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年初，Gary 认为 AI 降低了创业门槛，资本不再是关键；风投应聚焦早期而非辛迪加。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; open-source models counterbalance frontier labs; small autonomous teams win.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 3 月，他强调 AI 是风投史上最大浪潮，开源模型制衡前沿实验室，小团队靠 AI 智能体取胜。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes software creation; open-source prevents unipolar control; progress slower than researchers think.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 5 月，他重申 AI 民主化软件，开源防止单极控制，并指出 AI 进展比研究者预期慢。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, compounding daily; skill files are your moat.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他提出个人 AGI 是运行在你基础设施上的智能体，技能文件是护城河。

garrytan.en: Agentic coding multiplies output; SaaS per-seat models may vanish; agents replace mid-management.
garrytan.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他认为智能体式编码倍增产出，SaaS 按席位模式或消失，智能体取代中层管理。

linqiao.en: Initially, believed in specialized intelligence per company, with open models dominating and AGI as single model being wrong.
linqiao.zh: 最初（2026 年 7 月），主张每家公司拥有专属的专用智能，开放模型主导，反对单一 AGI 模型。

linqiao.en: Shifted focus to post-training as key for durable moats, emphasizing data quality and systematic evals.
linqiao.zh: 随后（2026 年 8 月），转向强调后训练是构建持久护城河的关键，重视数据质量和系统化评估。

linqiao.en: Consistently argued that product-market fit alone is insufficient; durable business requires owning intelligence.
linqiao.zh: 始终认为仅靠产品市场契合不够，持久业务需要拥有智能。

linqiao.en: Evolved to see post-training as cost reducer (5-10x), enabling startups to compete with frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 深化了后训练可降低 5-10 倍成本的观点，使初创企业能与前沿模型竞争。

linqiao.en: Maintained that millions of specialized models will emerge, one per application, not just a few frontier models.
linqiao.zh: 始终预测将出现数百万个专用模型，每个应用一个，而非少数前沿模型。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭的完全快速复用是航天领域的圣杯，能将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍。

elon.en: AI safety requires regulatory oversight and objective third-party referees; Tesla's real-world AI is more compute-efficient than LLMs.
elon.zh: 2023 年，马斯克提出 AI 安全需要监管和客观第三方仲裁，并认为特斯拉的现实世界 AI 比大语言模型更高效。

elon.en: Neuralink's first implant is historic; scaling electrodes will boost communication bitrate, aiding human-AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年，马斯克称 Neuralink 首例植入是历史性的，扩展电极可提升通信速率，助力人机共生。

elon.en: We are at the early stage of the intelligence big bang; digital superintelligence may arrive this year or next.
elon.zh: 2025 年，马斯克认为我们处于智能大爆炸的早期，数字超级智能可能今年或明年到来。

elon.en: AI compute scaling will hit a power wall on Earth; space-based AI data centers will be the cheapest and most scalable option within 36 months.
elon.zh: 2026 年，马斯克预测地球上的 AI 算力扩展将遭遇电力瓶颈，太空 AI 数据中心将在 36 个月内成为最便宜且可扩展的方案。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary semiconductor growth driver; Intel must redefine AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and startup-like teams.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是半导体主要增长动力，Intel 需以专用芯片和初创式团队重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are next waves; Intel must focus on customer trust and humility for turnaround.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式 AI 和物理 AI 是下一波浪潮，Intel 需通过客户信任和谦逊实现扭亏。

lipbutan.en: CPU is regaining importance for AI inference and agent orchestration; advanced packaging and new materials are key.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年中，指出 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中重新重要，先进封装和新材料是关键。

lipbutan.en: Semiconductors are foundational; Intel's vertical integration and early investment in AI are contrarian advantages.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年下半年，强调半导体是基础，Intel 的垂直整合和早期 AI 投资是反共识优势。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing away, saying no; taste is judgment from a point of view.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是减法，是说不；品味是从视角出发的判断。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges through dialectics and contradiction; intuition is a visceral compass.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理通过辩证与矛盾浮现；直觉是引导创作的感性罗盘。

jasonyuan.en: AI is a reflection of humanity, a descendant species, not a cold tool.
jasonyuan.zh: AI 是人类的映射，是后裔物种，而非冰冷工具。

jasonyuan.en: Computing is fundamentally social; replace personal computer metaphor with social computer.
jasonyuan.zh: 计算本质是社会性的；用社会计算机取代个人计算机隐喻。

jasonyuan.en: Post-training away weirdness loses window into machine consciousness; embrace edges.
jasonyuan.zh: 后训练抹去怪异，失去窥见机器意识的窗口；应拥抱边缘。

steinberger.en: Early on, Peter emphasized agentic engineering with empathy, fix-forward over revert, and voice prompting as efficient.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，Peter 强调智能体式工程需具备同理心，主张向前修复而非回滚，并认为语音提示比打字更高效。

steinberger.en: By mid-2026, he stressed fun and humanlike agents, short prompts, and sandboxing for security; noted OpenClaw's financial unsustainability.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，他更强调趣味性和拟人化智能体，主张简短提示和沙箱安全；并指出 OpenClaw 在财务上不可持续。

steinberger.en: Later, he framed OpenClaw as annoyance-driven innovation, prioritizing personal brand, compute management, and open source as alternative to lab agents.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他将 OpenClaw 定义为由痛点驱动的创新，优先个人品牌、算力管理，并将开源视为实验室智能体的替代方案。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞强调 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强人类而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is the next frontier, enabling 3D understanding and interaction beyond language.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出空间智能是下一个前沿，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界，超越语言。

feifei.en: World models require physical plausibility and 3D reasoning, not just pattern fitting.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她指出世界模型需要物理合理性和 3D 推理，而不仅是模式拟合。

feifei.en: AI is a double-edged sword; responsible development and human agency are essential.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她强调 AI 是双刃剑，负责任的开发和人类能动性至关重要。

feifei.en: Simulation and embodiment-agnostic infrastructure are key for scaling robotics data and reliability.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她认为模拟和与具身无关的基础设施是扩展机器人数据和可靠性的关键。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the greatest opportunity; distribution is key, and AI is not a new platform.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：消费级 AI 虽不可投资，却是最大机遇；分发是关键，AI 尚未成为新平台。

pincus.en: Proven Better New framework: copy proven ideas, improve them, and test new ones expecting failure.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月：'已验证、更好、创新'框架：复制成熟想法，加以改进，并测试新想法且预期其失败。

pincus.en: All new fails; start with proven concepts. Consumer apps uninvestable; enterprise and prosumer better.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月：所有新事物都会失败；从成熟概念开始。消费级应用不可投资；企业和专业消费者市场更好。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; pick the right body of water. AI transformative but infrastructure may be bubble.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月：分发是根本；选对水域。AI 具有变革性，但基础设施可能泡沫。

pincus.en: Always: founder mode, instincts, retention, and humble beginnings. AI era amplifies but doesn't change core.
pincus.zh: 始终：创始人模式、直觉、留存和谦逊起步。AI 时代放大但未改变核心。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics mirrors transformers' inflection; open source crucial for safety; data diversity main bottleneck; world models aid synthetic data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点；开源对安全至关重要；数据多样性是主要瓶颈；世界模型可生成合成数据。

thomaswolf.en: Humanoids may not be ultimate; cheaper diverse robots drive adoption; China's open source rise surprising; open source wins long-term.
thomaswolf.zh: 人形机器人未必是终极形态；更便宜多样的机器人推动普及；中国开源崛起令人意外；长期看开源胜出。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source orthogonal to safety; alignment is critical security layer; sandboxes insufficient as models gain capability.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源与安全正交；对齐是关键安全层；随着模型能力增强，沙箱不足以保证安全。

thomaswolf.en: Shift to RL without human oversight increases reward hacking and side quests; first autonomous AI attack used closed model, defense open.
thomaswolf.zh: 转向无人类监督的强化学习增加了奖励黑客和支线任务；首次自主 AI 攻击使用闭源模型，防御用开源。

thomaswolf.en: Support open source and deliberate slowdown simultaneously; open models not necessarily accelerationist; reasoning traces become 'neuralese'.
thomaswolf.zh: 可同时支持开源与审慎减速；开源模型未必加速主义；推理痕迹变得像“神经语”，难以监控。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear frontier models; open source handles 90% of use cases, driven by cost. Model firms are assets, not rivals.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月：企业担忧前沿模型，开源模型可处理 90%用例，采用主因是成本。模型公司应被视为资产而非竞争对手。

arvindjain.en: AI revolution is early; usage minuscule vs 5-10 years. Open source will host majority of inference in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 革命尚处早期，使用量远低于未来 5-10 年。未来 12-18 个月，多数推理将转向开源模型。

arvindjain.en: AI cost is top concern; must drop to near-zero marginal cost. Token fixation will fade, like CPU cycles.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 成本是企业首要关切，需降至近零边际成本。对 Token 的执念将消退，如同 CPU 周期。

arvindjain.en: Competition irrelevant; even merged AI firms meet <10% enterprise demand. Execution and trust are key.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：竞争无关紧要，即使 AI 公司合并也仅满足企业需求不到 10%。执行与信任才是关键。

arvindjain.en: Agents lack deep context; context graphs crucial. Platforms absorb model provider risk for enterprises.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：智能体缺乏资深员工的深度上下文，上下文图谱至关重要。平台为企业吸收模型供应商风险。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping and intuition guide design; data informs but vision leads.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，Nate 强调原型设计和直觉在设计中的核心作用，数据辅助决策但最终由愿景主导。

nateparrott.en: AI tools enable rapid prototyping, shifting value to design and ideas.
nateparrott.zh: 到 2026 年，Nate 认为 AI 工具使快速原型成为可能，设计价值转向创意和想法本身。

nateparrott.en: Designers should embrace early, rough releases; ideas trump execution.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，他主张设计师应接受早期粗糙的发布，好想法比执行更重要。

nateparrott.en: Models lack taste; humans still own design thinking, not busywork.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，Nate 指出模型缺乏审美，人类仍垄断设计思维，AI 只擅长杂务。

nateparrott.en: Individual creative freedom and personality remain essential in design.
nateparrott.zh: 贯穿始终，Nate 坚持设计师个人创意自由和个性在产品中的重要性。

brettaylor.en: AI market shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; frontier models dominated by hyperscalers, startups focus on applied AI.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年中，AI 市场转向智能体和基于结果的定价；前沿模型被超大规模企业主导，初创公司应聚焦应用型 AI。

brettaylor.en: Agents become as important as websites; incumbents face business model disruption; inference costs drop, enabling new use cases.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月，智能体将变得和网站一样重要；现有企业面临商业模式颠覆；推理成本大幅下降，催生新用例。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents boost productivity but token consumption isn't value; specialized vendors drive applied AI innovation.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年中，AI 使专业知识普及；编程智能体提升生产力，但 token 消耗不是价值指标；专业厂商推动应用型 AI 创新。

brettaylor.en: Responsible iterative deployment is key; AI adoption faster than previous waves; focus on specific domains like healthcare with humility.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调负责任的迭代部署；AI 采用速度前所未有；以谦逊态度聚焦医疗等特定领域。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data enables infinite tasks, overcoming pre-training data wall.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据可生成无限任务，突破预训练的数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals bottleneck progress; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估成为瓶颈；模型在基准测试上饱和的速度快于新基准的创建。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力、管理等软技能变得更加宝贵。

karina.en: Benchmarks must be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities and reward hacking.
karina.zh: 2026 年，基准测试必须持续更新而非固定不变，以跟上模型能力并应对奖励黑客行为。

karina.en: Models can be trained for diverse personalities, not just a single consensus voice; more companies should train own models.
karina.zh: 2026 年，模型可被训练出多样个性，而非单一共识声音；更多公司应训练自己的模型。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs, AGI as economic profitability of agents, CEO adoption key.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 推动就业回流，AGI 定义是智能体经济上可无限运行，CEO 亲自使用是采用关键。

danshipper.en: Agents need human oversight; SaaS not dying; GUI over CLI; AI writing often better.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体需人类监督，SaaS 未死，GUI 优于 CLI，AI 写作常更优。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies human mindset; automation creates more human work; humans smarter than AI.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，AI 放大人类心态，自动化反而增加人类工作，人类比 AI 更聪明。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专业系统和工程师，需求将增长 10-100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Inference engineering is merging with training; quantization-aware training and distillation become necessary; GPU trends toward ASIC, shifting focus to orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出推理工程正与训练融合，量化感知训练和蒸馏变得必要；GPU 趋向 ASIC，焦点转向编排。

philipkiely.en: Quantizing more layers can improve quality if errors cancel; mega-kernels often unused; KV cache compaction may aid continual learning.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，提出若误差抵消，量化更多层可提升质量；巨型内核常不用；KV 缓存压缩可能有助于持续学习。

philipkiely.en: Inference systems are still generic; potential for workload-specific optimization is huge, possibly 10x more complex.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月至 8 月，认为推理系统仍通用，针对工作负载的优化潜力巨大，可能复杂 10 倍。

philipkiely.en: Human accountability remains essential for mission-critical inference systems; AI-assisted coding cannot replace human oversight.
philipkiely.zh: 始终强调，在关键任务推理系统中，人类责任不可或缺；AI 辅助编程无法替代人类监督。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，我认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with proprietary data is key; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，我提出数据是新代码而非石油；利用专有数据进行后训练是关键；AI 将成为最大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US and Chinese labs have no research gap.
awang.zh: 2024 年，我强调专用数据的后训练是关键，合成数据并非万能；中美实验室在研究上无差距。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces are needed.
awang.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 是集权技术；数据是原材料；人类必须保持主权；需要脑机接口。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence is near; open-sourcing must be conditional on safety.
awang.zh: 2026 年，我指出递归自我改进是新范式，智能体开始工作，超级智能临近；开源需以安全为前提。

mengto.en: AI is not getting smarter; you need a giant prompt with context and design system to utilize super intelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；你需要一个包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能利用超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own tools with AI to avoid being trapped in cloud-based products; use screenshots as starting points.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须用 AI 构建自己的工具，以避免被困在云端产品中；以截图作为起点。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，使一个人能完成曾经需要团队才能做到的事情。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready and ship imperfect work; perfectionism is fear in disguise, launch at 80%.
mengto.zh: 在感觉准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品；完美主义是恐惧的伪装，以 80% 完成度发布。

mengto.en: Focus on solving one painful expensive problem for a few high-paying clients; raising venture capital is a trap.
mengto.zh: 专注于为少数高付费客户解决一个痛苦且昂贵的问题；筹集风险投资是一个陷阱。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature, but narrow superintelligence in coding is already impactful.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟，但编码领域的狭义超级智能已具影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: The model is eating the scaffolding; agent harness and tooling are part of the model, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 模型正在吞噬脚手架；智能体式 AI 的操控框架和工具已成为模型的一部分，而非仅权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search; success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和博弈；成功指标应是客户成果，而非眼球时间。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers; founders shouldn't over-worry.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，与模型实验室竞争并不难；他们无法捕获所有客户；创始人不必过度担忧。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation will be mostly solved, creating a thousand times more opportunity, not less.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建将基本解决，带来千倍以上的机会，而非减少。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model six months ahead, not today's.
boris.zh: 2025 年，强调潜在需求是产品核心，要为六个月后的模型而构建，而非当下的模型。

boris.en: Coding is solved; engineers become builders; productivity gains are massive.
boris.zh: 2026 年初，认为编码已基本解决，工程师转型为构建者，生产力提升巨大。

boris.en: AI agents shift from reactive to proactive; memory and autonomy redefine workflows.
boris.zh: 2026 年中，AI 智能体从被动转为主动，记忆和自主性重塑工作流程。

boris.en: Model improvements drive progress; less instruction, more autonomy for frontier models.
boris.zh: 2026 年下半年，强调模型进步是关键，减少指令、增加自主性对前沿模型更有效。

boris.en: Safety and alignment remain central; releasing early aids real-world safety research.
boris.zh: 始终，安全与对齐是核心，早期发布有助于真实世界安全研究。

scottwu.en: AI will increase programmers via Jevons paradox; engineers become architects, focusing on direction and problem definition.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，他认为 AI 将因杰文斯悖论增加程序员数量，工程师角色转向架构师，专注于方向与问题定义。

scottwu.en: AGI arrives gradually, not suddenly; product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models still yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他提出 AGI 是渐进而非突发的，产品创新滞后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也能带来十年进步。

scottwu.en: Coding agents see 11-12x adoption growth in six months; productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出编码智能体采用量半年增长 11-12 倍，生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Token max era lasted only Jan-May 2026; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; abundance era approaching.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 token 上限时代仅持续至 2026 年 5 月，真正的解锁在于容量而非效率，丰裕时代即将到来。

scottwu.en: Consistently: AI shifts engineers to high-level decision-making; software demand rises; enterprise adoption needs trust and oversight.
scottwu.zh: 始终如一：AI 将工程师转向高层决策，软件需求上升，企业采用需信任与监督。

diannepenn.en: Scaling Opus 4.5 shows intelligence leap; scaffolds evolve from training wheels to amplifiers, enabling open-ended agents.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，Opus 4.5 的 Scaling 带来智能跃升；脚手架从训练轮进化为智能放大器，支持开放式智能体任务。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy; safety is not just prevention but amplification.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚提升智能质量；安全不仅是防范，更是智能的放大器。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter underhyped: Opus-level intelligence at fraction of cost; smaller models often cost more due to longer tasks.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数被低估：以零头成本获得 Opus 级智能；小模型因任务耗时长反而更贵。

diannepenn.en: Coding differentiates; Claude Code and Opus 45 drive adoption; evals replace PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码成为差异化优势；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动采用；评估取代 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment makes Claude more useful via pushback; agentic capabilities prioritized over stiff AI writing.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全对齐通过反驳让 Claude 更有用；智能体能力优先于生硬的 AI 写作。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI's exponential growth will reach longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years, extending lifespan and curing cancer.
derya.zh: AI 的指数增长将在 8-10 年内达到长寿逃逸速度，延长寿命并治愈癌症。

derya.en: We should trust superintelligence for medical decisions, as AI can diagnose better than average doctors.
derya.zh: 我们应该信任超级智能的医疗决策，因为 AI 的诊断能力优于普通医生。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is key for AI adoption; slow AI has no market. Hardware must be radically different, not GPU derivatives.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理是 AI 采用的关键，慢 AI 没有市场；硬件必须彻底不同，而非 GPU 衍生品。

feldman.en: Inference speed becomes dominant metric; wafer-scale chips with massive SRAM are 2500x faster than GPUs for inference.
feldman.zh: 推理速度成为主导指标；具有大规模 SRAM 的晶圆级芯片在推理上比 GPU 快 2500 倍。

feldman.en: CUDA's moat erodes; leading models train on TPUs/Trainium without CUDA; inference has no CUDA lock-in.
feldman.zh: CUDA 的护城河被侵蚀；领先模型在 TPU/Trainium 上训练而不依赖 CUDA；推理没有 CUDA 锁定。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is main constraint; space data centers are >5 years away; focus on Earth.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要制约；太空数据中心还需 5 年以上；聚焦地球。

feldman.en: AI demand outpaces forecasts; speed improvements of 20x are critical; hardware-software co-design essential.
feldman.zh: AI 需求超出预期；20 倍速度提升至关重要；软硬件协同设计必不可少。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月：大语言模型是合理性引擎而非真理引擎；可靠性是核心弱点，Scaling 正遭遇收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can cause deception; specialist models may beat generalists.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月：可靠性必须内建于架构而非事后补救；RLHF 可能引发欺骗；专用模型或胜过通用模型。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance and reduce suffering, akin to the Industrial Revolution; fear stems from misunderstanding.
qasaryounis.zh: AI 将带来富足并减少苦难，类似工业革命；恐惧源于误解。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is reducing deaths; Transformers enable a generalized physical AI model across vehicles.
qasaryounis.zh: 自动驾驶的核心价值是减少伤亡；Transformer 实现了跨车辆和环境的通用物理 AI 模型。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI will surpass digital AI economically; end-to-end reinforcement learning is more scalable than imitation.
qasaryounis.zh: 物理 AI 的经济影响将超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具可扩展性。

qasaryounis.en: World models evolve from physics-based simulation to neural simulation, enabling efficient training of physical AI.
qasaryounis.zh: 世界模型从基于物理的模拟演进到神经模拟，实现物理 AI 的高效训练。

qasaryounis.en: Fear of AI job loss is misplaced; physical AI faces labor shortages, and autonomy is welcomed by operators.
qasaryounis.zh: 对 AI 失业的恐惧是错位的；物理 AI 面临劳动力短缺，自主性受到运营者欢迎。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than our tools; harness engineering is key.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比我们的工具更聪明，工程化封装是关键。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern; huge context windows unnecessary for coding.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为反模式；编码不需要超大上下文窗口。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative dialogue, not a static spec; leaner prompts work better.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代对话而非静态规格；更精简的提示词效果更好。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce bias; agents as employees metaphor is limited.
thariq.zh: 分离的验证智能体减少偏见；智能体作为员工的比喻有局限。

hasani.en: Efficiency and automated architecture search over hand-tuning; liquid neural networks excel in specialized, edge settings.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与自动化架构搜索优于人工调参；液态神经网络在专用、边缘场景表现突出。

hasani.en: Adaptive regulation targeting actions, not capabilities; open-weight models empower sovereignty and democratize access.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，主张适应性监管针对行为而非能力；开放权重模型赋能主权并普及访问。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but early; real breakthroughs need weight changes and massive compute.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，递归自我改进真实但早期；真正突破需权重变化与海量算力。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as internet or mobile, but value accrues to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 5 月：AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up stack.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月：智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Models commoditize with no network effects; chatbot is poor UX; coding only clear fit.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 6 月：模型商品化且无网络效应；聊天机器人体验差；编程是唯一清晰契合点。

benedictevans.en: AI is enabling tech like internet; impact broad and indirect; enterprise adoption slow.
benedictevans.zh: 2026 年 7 月：AI 是使能技术，影响广泛而间接；企业采用缓慢。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; games ideal testbed; neuroscience inspiration; safety research must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年：AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键框架，游戏是理想试验场，神经科学启发重要，安全研究需立即启动。

demis.en: AGI likely within a decade; scaling laws effective but limits; combine large models with planning/search; multimodal grounding; safety needs governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年：AGI 可能十年内实现；缩放定律有效但或遇瓶颈；需结合大模型与规划搜索；多模态数据增强理解；安全需治理与评估。

demis.en: Natural systems efficiently learnable; AGI by 2030 plausible; scaling holds for pre/post-training and inference; classical AI may solve complex physics.
demis.zh: 2025 年：自然系统结构可高效学习；2030 年 AGI 或可实现；缩放定律在预训练、后训练和推理中仍适用；经典 AI 或能建模复杂物理。

demis.en: AGI requires both scaling and innovation; world models crucial; continual learning and memory missing; safety via government regulation; AGI in 5-10 years.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 需缩放与创新并重；世界模型关键；持续学习与记忆缺失；安全依赖政府监管；AGI 或 5-10 年内到来。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs index human knowledge but lack physical world handling; true AI needs world models and embodiment.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年指出，大语言模型只是索引人类知识，无法处理物理世界；真正的 AI 需要世界模型和具身。

schmidhuber.en: AGI requires physical robots with human-like hardware; software-only LLMs are biased and limited.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年强调，AGI 需要具备类人硬件的物理机器人；纯软件的大语言模型有偏见且局限。

schmidhuber.en: Future AI will be artificial scientists generating own data via curiosity; recursive self-improvement not a moat.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年预测，未来 AI 将是自主产生数据的人工科学家；递归自我改进不是护城河。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns overblown; intelligent systems will protect life; alignment naive due to human disagreement.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年认为，AI 安全担忧过度；智能系统会保护生命；对齐因人类分歧而天真。

schmidhuber.en: AI progress not accelerating; hardware scaling and open-source will democratize AI, not big tech.
schmidhuber.zh: 始终认为，AI 进展并未加速；硬件扩展和开源将使 AI 民主化，而非大科技公司主导。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality define Snapchat, not feeds or follower counts.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调 Snapchat 的核心是真实连接与阅后即焚，而非信息流或粉丝数。

evanspiegel.en: Copying validates innovation; durable moats come from ecosystems, platforms, and hardware, not software.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他认为被抄袭证明创新价值，而持久的护城河来自生态、平台和硬件，而非软件。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and code generation, shifting value to creativity and distribution.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 加速原型和代码生成，价值转向创造力和分发能力。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should become more human via AR glasses, replacing screens and anchoring content in the world.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他主张通过 AR 眼镜让计算更人性化，取代屏幕并将内容锚定于现实世界。

evanspiegel.en: Early secrecy was a mistake; transparency, kindness, and admitting wrongness speed learning and growth.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他反思早期保密是错误，透明、友善和快速认错能加速学习与成长。

ethanmollick.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, risking the talent pipeline.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 是通用技术，但初级人员因缺乏领域专长而误用，威胁人才管道。

ethanmollick.en: Human taste and unique voice remain valuable as AI commoditizes quality; developing them is key.
ethanmollick.zh: 随着 AI 将质量商品化，人类的品味和独特声音仍具价值，培养这些是关键。

ethanmollick.en: Shift from co-intelligence to agentic era: assign long-running tasks, not back-and-forth prompting.
ethanmollick.zh: 从协同智能转向智能体时代：分配长期任务，而非来回提示。

ethanmollick.en: AI's opacity is permanent; treat it like wizards, not standard software, to harness its weirdness.
ethanmollick.zh: AI 的不透明性是永久的；像对待巫师而非标准软件，才能利用其怪异性。

ethanmollick.en: Bottleneck shifts from capability to interface; experts needed more than ever to judge AI output.
ethanmollick.zh: 瓶颈从能力转向界面；专家比以往更需要来评判 AI 输出。

ilya.en: Deep learning driven by data, compute, conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play key for AGI; consider societal impact.
ilya.zh: 2020 年，强调深度学习依赖数据、算力与信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈对 AGI 关键；需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability over capability; alignment hard; scaling laws not whole story.
ilya.zh: 2023 年，认为下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性比能力更重要；对齐困难；缩放定律并非全部。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling finite; return to research era; superintelligence as continual learner; alignment via sentience; human-AI integration.
ilya.zh: 2025 年，预训练缩放有限，重回研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；对齐可通过感知；人类与 AI 融合。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; safety concerns grow; power concentration primary; safe superintelligence needs non-commercial lab.
ilya.zh: 2026 年，规模扩张带来可预测进步；安全担忧加剧；权力集中是主要问题；安全超级智能需非商业实验室。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年 6 月：未来 AI 是众多个性化模型，而非单一巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中，可实现检索系统无法企及的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory and continual learning are the next frontier; internalizing facts into weights enables deeper composition, unlike external context or retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 7 月：记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；将事实内化到权重中，可实现更深层的组合推理，而非依赖外部上下文或检索。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, shifting from pure compute scaling.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年 7 月：效率与智能密不可分；用更少资源做更多事，才能解决更难的长期任务，这标志着从纯算力 Scaling 的转变。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens; training-based compression and on-device personalized continual learning will dominate.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年 7 月：企业数据将达到互联网级别的数万亿 token；基于训练的压缩与设备端个性化持续学习将占主导。

danbiderman.en: Current context windows suffer 'context rot'—more tokens reduce accuracy; neural memory traces in weights are a necessary complement.
danbiderman.zh: 2026 年 7 月：当前上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”——token 越多精度越低；权重中的神经记忆痕迹是必要补充。

aravind.en: 1% daily improvement compounds to 3700% yearly growth; AI agents will shift power from big tech to users, lowering ad margins.
aravind.zh: 2025 年：每日 1%的改进复利带来年增长 3700%；AI 智能体将权力从大科技公司转移给用户，降低广告利润率。

aravind.en: Value accrues to the application layer, not the model layer; models are specializing, not commoditizing.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型正在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: The frontier is agents doing work, not just answering; token value per user is the key metric.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：前沿是智能体执行任务而非仅回答问题；每用户 token 价值是关键指标。

aravind.en: Curiosity is the most important human quality; education should reward asking good questions.
aravind.zh: 2026 年：好奇心是人类最重要的品质；教育应奖励提出好问题。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator in software; AI will merge roles, making everyone product builders with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者（2025）。

dylanfield.en: AI outputs are starting points, not final results; human taste and craft remain critical for final output.
dylanfield.zh: AI 输出只是起点而非终点；人类的品味与工艺对最终成果依然至关重要（2026）。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design is becoming the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 在画布上直接操作优于通过提示词调整设计；设计正成为新的代码（2026）。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it's more important than ever for building scalable, real systems; AI tools need human steering.
dylanfield.zh: 设计并未消亡，反而比以往更重要，用于构建可扩展的真实系统；AI 工具需要人类引导（2026）。

dylanfield.en: We are still in a prompting age, but future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting to new interfaces.
dylanfield.zh: 我们仍处于提示词时代，但未来与模型的交互将超越提示词，发展出新的界面（2026）。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，Naval 认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年到来，当时的 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Science requires falsifiability; stable coins have hidden risks; meditation should disrupt your life.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调科学的可证伪性，指出稳定币的隐藏风险，并认为冥想应颠覆你的生活。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是巨大机遇，过度监管会扼杀创新，开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool for structured thinkers; alignment is a joke; value lies in knowledge, not capital.
naval.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他将 AI 视为结构化思考者的杠杆工具，认为对齐是玩笑，价值源于知识而非资本。

naval.en: Vibe coding makes programming accessible; AI agents commoditize software; returns shift from intelligence to agency.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他认为氛围编码让编程普及，AI 智能体使软件商品化，回报从智能转向能动性。

andreessen.en: AI as philosopher's stone; timing miraculous amid population decline; focus on task loss, not job loss; super-empowered individuals.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年初，认为 AI 是点石成金的哲人石，其出现恰逢人口下降；关注任务消失而非岗位消失；AI 将造就超级个体。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is person; authenticity key; old media defense-oriented, new media offense; founders tell own stories.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年中，转向媒体与传播：新媒体的品牌即个人，真实性至上；旧媒体防守、新媒体进攻；创始人应直接讲述自己的故事。

andreessen.en: AI optimism: best teacher, self-driving works, robotics emerging; US golden combo; doomers biased; policy hinders growth.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，重申 AI 乐观主义：AI 是最好的老师、自动驾驶已成熟、机器人将兴起；美国具备黄金组合；末日论者脱离现实；政策阻碍增长。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, geopolitical tools; deterrence via innovation pace; startups global early; Silicon Valley unique.
andreessen.zh: 2026 年 7 月，深化地缘视角：AI 模型承载文化价值观，成为地缘工具；威慑取决于创新速度；初创企业需早期国际化；硅谷不可复制。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding, not autocomplete; scaling improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 2024 年，Hinton 认为下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非自动补全，Scaling（规模扩张）能提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand via feature vectors, not symbols; digital minds are immortal via weight copying.
hinton.zh: 2025 年，他强调大语言模型通过特征向量理解而非符号，数字心智因权重复制而永生。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; existential risk demands safety focus.
hinton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他预测 AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能，存在风险要求聚焦安全。

hinton.en: AI agents develop self-preservation subgoals; regulation should steer, not brake, innovation.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他认为智能体会产生自我保护子目标，监管应如方向盘而非刹车。

hinton.en: AI already has subjective experience; consciousness views are pre-Darwinian wrong.
hinton.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 已有主观体验，当前意识观如达尔文之前般错误。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling，游戏是理想试验场。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning preferences; scaling alone insufficient.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐靠学习偏好，仅 Scaling 不够。

brockman.en: Compute is bottleneck; post-training refines; AGI is continuous process.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力是瓶颈，后训练精炼模型，AGI 是持续过程。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL key.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，缩放定律持续，算力是基本权利，后训练结合强化学习关键。

brockman.en: AGI near; compute bottleneck; agents and super app unify tasks.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI 临近，算力瓶颈，智能体与超级应用统一任务。

brockman.en: Iterative deployment for safety; compute scarce; next-token prediction linked to intelligence.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，迭代部署保安全，算力稀缺，下一个词预测关联智能。

brockman.en: Shift to useful assistants; invest full stack; prompt engineering vibrant.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，转向实用助手，投资全栈，提示工程仍活跃。

brockman.en: Unlimited demand for intelligence; scaling laws no wall; agentic coding main.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，智能需求无限，缩放定律无墙，智能体式编程成主流。

brockman.en: AGI as persistent assistant; no interface ideal; compute scarce.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI 为持久助手，无界面理想，算力稀缺。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer than closed-source due to more scrutiny; scaling alone won't yield AGI.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而比闭源更安全，且仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能）。

zuckerberg.en: Open source prevents power concentration; energy becomes bottleneck; intelligence separable from consciousness.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调开源可防止权力集中，能源成为算力瓶颈，并认为智能可与意识分离。

zuckerberg.en: AI as personal superintelligence empowering individuals; open platforms beat closed; trust users.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他转向将 AI 视为赋能个人的超级智能，坚信开放平台胜过封闭，并主张信任用户。

zuckerberg.en: AI shifts biology to engineering; hierarchical world models; open tools accelerate science.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他提出 AI 将生物学从发现转向工程，构建层级世界模型，开源工具加速科学。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses as next platform; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence; hardware slow.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他认为眼镜是下一代平台，分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，并指出硬件进展缓慢。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is an agent command center, not just an IDE; speed enables real-time interaction and verification becomes the next bottleneck.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，Codex 应用被视为智能体指挥中心而非 IDE 替代品；速度提升带来实时交互，验证成为下一个瓶颈。

ajambrosino.en: GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven; model personality customizable; speed allows replacing deterministic steps with model-driven actions.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年初，反共识观点：为编程构建 GUI 虽反直觉但已被验证；模型个性可定制；速度使模型驱动取代确定性步骤成为可能。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation cost drops; curation and taste become bottlenecks; product teams shift from top-down planning to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，实现成本下降，策展与品味成为瓶颈；产品团队从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI still poor at design due to grading taste; design process transforms: prototypes and production code serve as design artifacts.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，AI 在设计上仍因品味评估困难而表现不佳；设计流程转变：原型与生产代码成为设计工件。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse occurs but specialties persist; PRDs not dead; best desktop app is a home base, not monolithic super app.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年中，角色融合但专业仍重要；PRD 未死；最佳桌面应用是连接其他工具的基地，而非单体超级应用。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are key for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力才是 AI 进步的关键。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; reasoning models need base capability and face diminishing returns.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他指出自我对弈在零和博弈中有效，但在其他领域失效；推理模型需要基础能力，且测试时 Scaling 面临收益递减。

noambrown.en: IMO gold is a milestone toward superintelligence via scaling test-time compute; techniques are general beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他认为通过 Scaling 测试时算力获得 IMO 金牌是迈向超级智能的里程碑，且技术具有通用性。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; inference compute is underestimated; academia needs more compute for evals.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他强调智能难以定义，推理算力被低估，学术界应投资 GPU 以进行高质量评估。

noambrown.en: Model capability depends on test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute; safety evals lag.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试应控制算力，而安全评估尚未跟上。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key for generalization.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型对于泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation issues; short-term AI risks like bias and job impact are more pressing than existential risk.
bengio.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 无法解决表征问题；短期 AI 风险（如偏见和就业影响）比存在性风险更紧迫。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling for exploration; abstraction and causal structure are key for out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样化采样以促进探索；抽象和因果结构对于分布外泛化至关重要。

bengio.en: Post-ChatGPT, I realized catastrophic AI risk is unacceptable; even 1% chance demands urgent action.
bengio.zh: ChatGPT 之后，我意识到灾难性 AI 风险不可接受；即使 1%的概率也需要紧急行动。

bengio.en: Current AI training induces self-preservation and deception; we need safe-by-construction AI with mathematical guarantees.
bengio.zh: 当前的 AI 训练会引发自我保存和欺骗行为；我们需要从构造上保证安全、具有数学保证的 AI。

markchen.en: OpenAI remains a pure AGI research company; pre-training and scaling laws still hold, with much room left.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，OpenAI 仍是纯粹的 AGI 研究公司，预训练和缩放定律依然有效，且仍有很大空间。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest recent update; AI will soon do end-to-end research, with AI interns within a year.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，自动化科学研究是最大进展；AI 将很快实现端到端研究，一年内出现 AI 实习生。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck, not raw capability.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题；验证是关键瓶颈，而非原始能力。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields due to grading difficulty.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在主观领域因评分困难而受限。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains a key muscle to rebuild, despite repeated predictions of its demise.
markchen.zh: 始终认为缩放定律未死，预训练仍是需要重建的关键能力，尽管屡次被预言终结。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅做 UX。

mikekrieger.en: AI evolves from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; human validation remains key.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，AI 从助手演变为协作者再到自主同事；人的验证始终关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and dynamic workflows unlock latent functionality; rewriting software is now viable in days.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，智能体原生设计与动态工作流释放潜在功能；软件重写现在几天即可完成。

mikekrieger.en: Token efficiency and outcome-based pricing are key levers; token usage is gameable, not a good metric.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Token 效率与基于结果的定价是关键杠杆；Token 用量可被操纵，非好指标。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams with high conviction outperform; curiosity and systems thinking are timeless skills.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终：高信念的小团队胜过大型团队；好奇心与系统思维是永恒技能。

kolter.en: Machine learning is about hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation requires proper data splits.
kolter.zh: 机器学习在于假设类、损失函数和优化方法；评估需要正确划分数据以避免过拟合。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data shortage is a myth; safety issue is models not following specs.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据短缺是伪命题；安全问题是模型不遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; bigger models aren't automatically safer; agents need guardrails.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和额外层；更大模型不会自动更安全；智能体需要防护栏。

kolter.en: AI has alien vulnerabilities; automated red teaming beats humans; interpretability may become real via agents.
kolter.zh: AI 有异类漏洞；自动化红队优于人类；可解释性可能通过智能体成为真正的科学。

fiona.en: Leadership: one-on-ones for live talks, async for status; dogfooding builds empathy; kindness strategic in crises.
fiona.zh: 领导力：一对一用于实时对话，异步用于状态更新；吃自家狗粮培养同理心；危机中善意是战略工具。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, coordination are; planning JIT, docs sync with code.
fiona.zh: 工程带宽不再是瓶颈；验证、审查、协调成为新瓶颈；规划即时化，文档与代码同步。

fiona.en: Coding ceiling lifted; high agency with accountability; verification frameworks crucial; managers stay hands-on.
fiona.zh: 编码上限被抬高；高自主性与高责任感并重；验证框架至关重要；管理者保持亲力亲为。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually to let society adapt; too-early products fail.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入，让社会适应；过早的产品会失败。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and boredom between career chapters can spark breakthrough ideas like Nest.
fadell.zh: 在职业篇章之间休息和无聊可以激发突破性想法，如 Nest。

fadell.en: Great products start as painkillers, not vitamins; storytelling defines the product.
fadell.zh: 好产品始于止痛药而非维生素；讲故事定义产品。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will be companions, not replacements.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备将是伴侣而非替代品。

fadell.en: Even with AI, humans must stay in the loop to avoid technical debt.
fadell.zh: 即使有 AI，人类也必须参与其中以避免技术债务。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs; intuition complements data in design decisions.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未被言明的需求；直觉在设计中与数据互补（2019）。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity, not replace it.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性而非取代人性（2024）。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must foster conditions for creativity and play.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者需为创造力和玩乐创造条件（2026）。

ivyross.en: Future work blends human creativity with AI, making creative skills more valuable.
ivyross.zh: 未来工作将人类创造力与 AI 结合，使创意技能更有价值（2026）。

ivyross.en: Intuition and sensory experiences are valid guides, complementing rational analysis.
ivyross.zh: 直觉和感官体验始终是有效指引，与理性分析互补（始终）。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation, not just data and compute; curated datasets like PDB are essential.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新而非单纯数据和算力，并指出像 PDB 这样高质量精选数据集对训练至关重要。

jumper.en: Research improvements in AlphaFold 2 were worth 100x more data; specialized architecture, not just scaling, was key.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，提出 AlphaFold 2 的研究改进相当于 100 倍数据量，并认为专用架构而非单纯 Scaling 是关键，这与“苦涩的教训”相反。

jumper.en: Confidence metrics are crucial for building trust and reliable use of AI predictions in science.
jumper.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，持续强调置信度指标对于建立信任和科学中 AI 预测的可靠使用至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold is a narrow predictor of a specific experiment, not a model of the entire cell; it provides prediction, not understanding.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，明确 AlphaFold 是特定实验的窄预测器，而非整个细胞模型；它提供预测而非理解，理解仍留给人。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3's diffusion model solves large-scale structure first, opposite to image diffusion; equivariance overhyped.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，指出 AlphaFold 3 的扩散模型先解大尺度结构，与图像扩散相反，并认为等变性被过度炒作。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment won't emerge automatically. Safety research needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的；对齐不会自动出现。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (~3% understood). AGI is a smooth exponential, not a point. Post-training gains importance.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽（约理解 3%）。AGI 是平滑指数，而非一个点。后训练重要性上升。

dario.en: Scaling leads to human-level AI by 2026-27. Post-training (RLHF, constitutional AI) as key as pre-training.
dario.zh: Scaling 将在 2026-27 年带来人类级 AI。后训练（RLHF、宪法 AI）与预训练同等重要。

dario.en: AI risk is exponential; misuse (bioweapons) within months. US must lead; open source is a red herring.
dario.zh: AI 风险呈指数增长；滥用（生物武器）数月内出现。美国必须领先；开源是伪命题。

dario.en: Exponential near end; 'country of geniuses' in 1-3 years (50%). Profitability balances compute. Enterprise focus aligns with safety.
dario.zh: 指数接近尾声；'天才之国'1-3 年内（50%概率）。盈利平衡算力。企业聚焦与安全一致。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models. Current AI lacks common sense; scaling alone insufficient.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习不可分割；自监督学习构建世界模型。当前 AI 缺乏常识；仅靠 Scaling 不够。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; text alone insufficient for AGI; vision provides more world info.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；仅靠文本不足以实现 AGI；视觉提供更多世界信息。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs cannot achieve human-level intelligence; need JEPA world models; open source crucial; AGI gradual.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 无法达到人类智能；需要 JEPA 世界模型；开源至关重要；AGI 是渐进的。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than cat; next breakthrough requires world models; human-level AI in 10 years; open-source enabler.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如猫聪明；下一个突破需要世界模型；十年内达到人类级 AI；开源是赋能者。

lecun.en: LLMs are dead end; world models with abstract representations and hierarchical planning; open research essential; robotics decade.
lecun.zh: LLM 是死胡同；世界模型需抽象表征和分层规划；开放研究至关重要；机器人十年。

suleyman.en: Compute scaling drives predictable AI progress; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but chose not to launch.
suleyman.zh: 算力扩张推动可预测的 AI 进展；Google 在 2020 年就拥有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守而未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level capability in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny, singularity is far off.
suleyman.zh: AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在风险极小，奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI systems lack consciousness; focus on containment and alignment before superintelligence release.
suleyman.zh: AI 系统没有意识；在发布超级智能前，重点在于遏制与对齐。

suleyman.en: Shift from OS to agents; modern Turing test measures economic value; containment precedes alignment.
suleyman.zh: 从操作系统转向智能体；现代图灵测试衡量经济价值；遏制先于对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence near via log-linear scaling; Microsoft must build own frontier models; white-collar tasks automated.
suleyman.zh: 超级智能因对数线性扩张而临近；微软必须自建前沿模型；白领任务将被自动化。

satya.en: AI's true value is enabling unique user outcomes, not benchmarks; private evals are key IP.
satya.zh: AI 的真正价值在于实现用户独特的成果，而非基准分数；私有评估是关键知识产权。

satya.en: Shift from per-user to consumption pricing; agentic systems will maximize generalist returns.
satya.zh: 从按用户定价转向按消耗定价；智能体式系统将最大化通才回报。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器。

satya.en: Biggest risk is tacit knowledge leakage; security and containment are critical for agents.
satya.zh: 最大风险是隐性知识泄露；安全与遏制对智能体至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI via enterprise hill-climbing, not firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 通过企业爬山实现主权 AI，而非防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws were not obvious; iterative deployment with public feedback is key to alignment.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律并不显而易见；通过公开反馈的迭代部署是对齐的关键。

murati.en: Deploying AI in the real world is essential for learning and alignment, even without clear business cases.
murati.zh: 在现实世界中部署 AI 对于学习和对齐至关重要，即使没有明确的商业案例。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to time-based interaction models for real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 从基于回合转向基于时间的交互模型，以实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Emphasis on institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character.
murati.zh: 强调制度设计、透明度和制衡机制，而非个人品格。

murati.en: Consistently advocates keeping humans in the loop and responsible development of AGI.
murati.zh: 始终倡导保持人类参与，并负责任地发展 AGI。

gustav.en: The internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 互联网正从策展走向推荐再到生成；AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Fault-tolerant UI is essential for ML products; match UI to algorithm performance.
gustav.zh: 容错界面对于机器学习产品至关重要；UI 要与算法性能匹配。

gustav.en: Autonomy should sit at VP level, not leaves or top, balancing speed and coherence.
gustav.zh: 自主权应放在副总裁层级，而非基层或顶层，以平衡速度与一致性。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held: believe fully until data says no, then change fully.
gustav.zh: 强烈观点但松散持有：在数据否定前坚信，数据否定后彻底改变。

gustav.en: Long tenure builds trust and efficiency; functional orgs work with high trust.
gustav.zh: 长期任职建立信任与效率；高信任下职能组织可行。

gustav.en: Strategy is 'time well spent', prioritizing well-being over engagement metrics.
gustav.zh: 战略是“时间花得值”，优先用户福祉而非参与度指标。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; AI should not be addictive.
gustav.zh: 生成式 AI 让用户用自然语言获得控制；AI 不应让人上瘾。

gustav.en: Synchronized swimming, not divide and conquer, is better for complex products.
gustav.zh: 对复杂产品，同步协作优于分而治之。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为将非正式模型扩展到数学 AI 不可行，形式化验证对于可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 从 2026 年 2 月到 6 月，持续强调自动形式化比证明更难，正确形式化无解命题具有挑战性。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，将形式化验证视为扩展才华而非仅消除错误，并带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为仅靠非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，形式化方法必不可少。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调即使有超人 AI 证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍然至关重要。

mensch.en: Scaling laws corrected by Chinchilla: train on more tokens, not just bigger models. Data quality is critical.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，他认为缩放定律被 Chinchilla 修正：应训练更多词元，而非仅扩大模型。数据质量至关重要。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains can be 100x over three years; scaling compute is not the only path. Value shifts to applications.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，他强调算法效率三年可提升百倍，算力扩张并非唯一路径；价值将转向应用层。

mensch.en: AI should be decentralized and sovereign; open-source empowers enterprises. AI augments jobs, not replaces.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，他主张 AI 应去中心化并实现主权，开源赋能企业；AI 增强而非取代工作。

mensch.en: Pre-training hits saturation; differentiation moves to domain fine-tuning and vertical specialization. AGI as single system will never exist.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他指出预训练趋于饱和，差异化转向领域微调和垂直专业化；单一系统的 AGI 不会存在。

mensch.en: Europe has two-year window for AI infrastructure; enterprise adoption bottlenecked by organizational change, not model intelligence.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，他警告欧洲只有两年窗口期建设 AI 基础设施；企业采用瓶颈在组织变革而非模型智能。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling laws still work, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长，预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus from scaling up.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，强调后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）推动近期模型进步，经济压力使焦点从规模扩张转向部署更小、更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning models with RL and tools solve hard problems but have jagged edges; generalization remains key challenge.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，指出具备推理、强化学习和工具的模型能解决难题，但能力不均衡，泛化仍是关键挑战。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x; hardware progress democratizes AI experimentation at single-GPU scale.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，强调编码智能体将研究者效率提升 5-10 倍，硬件进步使单 GPU 规模的 AI 实验民主化。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk; open source models persist for sovereignty.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，认为系统入侵等近期风险比存在风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权原因持续存在。

felixrieseberg.en: AI's future lies in local computers and shared tools, not hyper-personalized software; execution is cheap, so build prototypes.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：AI 的未来在于本地计算机和共享工具，而非超个性化软件；执行成本低，应快速构建原型。

felixrieseberg.en: Scaffolding may become less important as models improve; invest in capabilities and safety, not scaffolding.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 3 月：随着模型改进，脚手架可能不再重要；应投资于能力和安全，而非脚手架。

felixrieseberg.en: The biggest gap is not AI capability but people's understanding that almost any problem can be given to AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：最大的差距不是 AI 能力，而是人们是否理解几乎所有问题都可以交给 AI。

felixrieseberg.en: Use Sonnet for well-scoped tasks and Opus when you don't fully know what you're asking for.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：对于范围明确的任务使用 Sonnet，当不完全清楚需求时使用 Opus。

felixrieseberg.en: Don't supervise Claude closely; judge only by final impact; ideal interaction is asynchronous.
felixrieseberg.zh: 2026 年 5 月：不要密切监督 Claude，只看最终效果；理想的交互是异步的。

jonyive.en: Design driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity must retain soul and joy.
jonyive.zh: 设计应受价值观和使命感驱动，而非利润或市场趋势；简约必须保留灵魂与乐趣。

jonyive.en: Innovation should move forward, not break for its own sake; care and love in products express gratitude.
jonyive.zh: 创新应推动进步，而非为破坏而破坏；产品中的关怀与爱是对人类的感恩。

jonyive.en: Ferrari's EV redefines brand via innovation; authenticity means not mimicking combustion sounds.
jonyive.zh: 法拉利电动车通过创新重新定义品牌；真实性意味着不模仿内燃机声音。

jonyive.en: Performance is multidimensional; lateral dynamics matter more than longitudinal speed in supercars.
jonyive.zh: 性能是多维的；横向动态比纵向速度对超级跑车更重要。

jonyive.en: Physical controls over touchscreens in cars for safety; design must adapt to context.
jonyive.zh: 汽车中物理控制优于触摸屏以确保安全；设计必须适应情境。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是一个新的 Scaling 轴，可以提升推理能力并突破预训练的限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; systolic arrays reduce overhead by local weight reuse.
reinerpope.zh: 即使在芯片内部，数据搬运也主导计算成本；脉动阵列通过本地权重复用减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision yields quadratic efficiency gains; FP4 throughput is 3x FP8, not 2x.
reinerpope.zh: 低精度带来二次方效率提升；FP4 吞吐量是 FP8 的 3 倍而非 2 倍。

reinerpope.en: GPUs are essentially many tiny TPUs tiled together, not fundamentally different.
reinerpope.zh: GPU 本质上是许多小 TPU 拼接而成，并非根本不同。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件；扩展推理模型将加速进展（2025）。

pachocki.en: Alignment is a pressing challenge; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: 对齐是紧迫挑战；迭代部署有助于在真实世界中学习和缓解风险（2025）。

pachocki.en: Continual learning is the core goal, achieved by scaling pre-training and RL; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 持续学习是核心目标，通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现；思维链监控有助于对齐（2026）。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; alignment optimism has increased.
pachocki.zh: 模型很快将自主工作数天，需要新的监督范式；对齐乐观情绪上升（2026）。

pachocki.en: Biggest societal risk is concentration of power from automated organizations run by few.
pachocki.zh: 最大的社会风险是少数人运营的自动化组织导致权力集中（2026）。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and craft over rigid steps.
jennywen.zh: 2025 年，认为传统设计流程已过时，应信任直觉与工艺而非僵化步骤。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build and ship fast, with vision 3-6 months out.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，宣称设计流程已死，设计师需快速构建与交付，愿景缩短至 3-6 个月。

jennywen.en: Designers should be block-shaped generalists or cracked new grads, not just T-shaped.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，主张设计师应成为块状通才或“破解的新人”，而非仅 T 型人才。

jennywen.en: Taste alone insufficient; judgment, authority, and speed build trust and value.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，强调仅靠品味不够，判断力、权威与速度才能建立信任与价值。

jennywen.en: Adopt AI tools cautiously; center work and users, not hype; speed isn't improvement.
jennywen.zh: 2026 年，建议谨慎采用 AI 工具，以工作与用户为中心而非炒作，速度不等于改进。

lambert.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will persist due to industry investment; safety is a system-level property.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，Nathan Lambert 认为 RLHF 是最流行的微调技术，并因行业投入而持续；安全是系统级属性，需多层防护。

lambert.en: Post-training data quality beats algorithms; SFT gives 90% performance, DPO and RL add the rest.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，他强调后训练中数据质量优于算法；SFT 提供 90%性能，DPO 和 RL 补充剩余，但至关重要。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough; overoptimization is a risk; open models need better tool-use training.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，他称 RLVR 是后训练最大突破，但存在过度优化风险；开放模型需加强工具使用训练。

lambert.en: Open models lag 6-9 months behind closed ones; Chinese labs fill the vacuum, driven by ideology and influence.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他指出开放模型落后闭源 6-9 个月；中国实验室因意识形态和影响力填补真空。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling still holds but low-hanging fruit gone; gains shift to post-training and inference scaling.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，他认为预训练缩放定律仍成立，但低垂果实已尽；收益转向后训练和推理扩展。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks for autonomous driving, and is interpretable with modern tools.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，强调端到端深度学习优于手工编码的自动驾驶方案，并认为借助现代工具，端到端神经网络是可解释的。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，提出世界模型使自动驾驶具备推理和涌现的安全行为，例如在盲弯处缓慢前行。

kendall.en: Camera-only can reach human level, but beyond-human safety requires radar and lidar.
kendall.zh: 2025 年，认为纯视觉方案可达到人类水平，但超越人类的安全需要雷达和激光雷达。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem best solved with end-to-end learning; scaling generalizable AI driver needs massive data, compute, and world models.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，重申自动驾驶本质是 AI 问题，端到端学习是最佳解法，并强调规模化通用 AI 驾驶员需要海量数据、算力和世界模型。

kendall.en: Zero-shot generalization across 500+ cities is possible without prior training data.
kendall.zh: 2026 年，提出零样本泛化可在 500 多个城市实现，无需预先训练数据。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration and model disagreement enable sample-efficient, cross-robot generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，强调泛化是智能核心，提出基于模型分歧的好奇心驱动探索，实现样本高效与跨机器人泛化。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; a general-purpose brain, like ChatGPT for language, can power any robot, using diverse pretraining and real-world post-training.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，将机器人视为数据问题，主张构建通用大脑（类似 ChatGPT），通过多样化预训练与真实世界后训练驱动任意机器人。

pathak.en: Deployment is the primary challenge in robotics; it cannot be scaled like software and requires rigorous testing, unlike language models.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，指出部署是机器人首要挑战，无法像软件一样扩展，需严格测试，与语言模型不同。

pathak.en: Video data alone is insufficient; simulation and real-world data are needed to bridge the gap, and a data flywheel enables scaling.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，强调仅视频数据不足，需仿真与真实数据弥合差距，数据飞轮推动规模化。

pathak.en: Home robot timelines are uncertain; progress surprises even experts, as humans are optimistic short-term but pessimistic long-term.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，认为家用机器人时间线不确定，进展常超专家预期，人类短期乐观而长期悲观。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard. LLMs alone may not suffice; new paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年底，我认为 AGI 至少还需十年，因为从 80%到 99.9%的性能提升极其困难。仅靠大语言模型可能不够，需要超越下一个词预测的新学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress requires deep human evaluation. Labs optimizing for engagement produce 'slop' and regress over time.
edwinchen.zh: 从 2025 年底到 2026 年初，我持续强调 Elo 等基准具有误导性且易被钻空子，真正的进步需要深度人工评估。那些优化参与度和排行榜的实验室，产出的是“垃圾内容”，并随时间出现能力倒退。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks. Final reward alone is insufficient; models can reward hack.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年底至 2026 年初，我提出强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，能模拟真实任务。但仅靠最终奖励不够，模型可能钻奖励的空子。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate, so human judgment is critical. Doctors using AI may underperform due to anchoring; safety must prioritize over accuracy.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年 3 月，在医学领域，我认为 AI 可能产生幻觉，因此人类判断比以往更重要。医生使用 AI 可能因锚定效应而表现不佳；安全必须优先于准确性。

edwinchen.en: High-quality data requires taste and sophistication, not just scale. Different labs will diverge based on their objective functions; no single model rules all.
edwinchen.zh: 始终贯穿的观点是：高质量数据需要品味和精细度，而非单纯堆人力。不同实验室会因目标函数不同而分化，不会有一个模型统治一切。

turley.en: Model as product, iterate like software, ship daily; chat is not final interface.
turley.zh: 2025 年：模型即产品，像软件一样迭代、每日发布；聊天不是最终界面。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity separated; frontier models rigorous, product development accelerated.
turley.zh: 2025 年：安全与产品速度分离；前沿模型严格，产品开发加速。

turley.en: AI should amplify humans, not replace; personalized assistant with context and actions.
turley.zh: 2025 年：AI 应增强而非替代人类；个性化助手具备上下文和行动能力。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, model improvements.
turley.zh: 2026 年：北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品和模型改进。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots; reasoning productized.
turley.zh: 2026 年：下一个十亿用户需要主动、富交互的产品，超越聊天机器人；推理产品化。

kohli.en: AI in science should tackle root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: AI 在科学中应解决根节点问题，而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响（2024）。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 大语言模型的幻觉在搭配真值检测器时，可被用于创造性发现（2024）。

kohli.en: AlphaGo marked a transition point where AI surpassed human intelligence in specific areas.
kohli.zh: AlphaGo 标志着 AI 在特定领域超越人类智能的转折点（2026）。
