kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 如今，基于强化学习的后训练是推动超越人类知识的关键（2026）。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 可解释性对于 AlphaFold 这类科学突破很重要，但并非必不可少（2026）。

carlpei.en: Building a brand unites teams on a higher purpose; survival is core for startups.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，裴宇强调品牌建设凝聚团队于更高使命，生存是初创公司的核心。

carlpei.en: Smartphone future lies in generative UI and proactive agentic software, not hardware.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年，他认为手机未来在于生成式界面和主动智能体式软件，而非硬件。

carlpei.en: AI models commoditize; focus on applied AI for consumers, not hype.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他坚持 AI 模型商品化，应聚焦面向消费者的应用 AI，而非炒作。

carlpei.en: Design is key differentiation; AI as ingredient, not marketing buzzword.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他强调设计是核心差异化，AI 只是体验的配料，而非营销噱头。

carlpei.en: Smartphones won't be replaced by glasses; only brain-computer interfaces could.
carlpei.zh: 始终认为手机不会被眼镜等取代，只有脑机接口才可能颠覆。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack grounded experience.
jimfan.zh: 具身对 AI 的落地和减少幻觉至关重要；LLM 缺乏具身经验（2023）。

jimfan.en: Simulation is key for training embodied agents, enabling parallelization and safe exploration.
jimfan.zh: 仿真对训练具身智能体至关重要，可实现并行化和安全探索（2023）。

jimfan.en: Data scarcity is the main bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 数据稀缺是机器人学的主要瓶颈；来自世界模型的合成数据是未来（2026）。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test—robot cleaning a messy house—is the grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 物理图灵测试——机器人打扫凌乱的房间——是具身 AI 的重大挑战（2026）。

jimfan.en: Intelligent robots will outnumber iPhones by 2040; GPT-3 moment for robotics in ~5 years.
jimfan.zh: 智能机器人数量将在 2040 年前超过 iPhone；机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻约在 5 年内到来（2026）。

nando.en: AI should augment human abilities, like microscopes; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths to AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，他认为 AI 应像显微镜一样增强人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体是通往 AGI 的可行路径。

nando.en: AI safety and responsible deployment are the biggest challenges; Africa leapfrogging legacy issues offers unique advantages.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他强调 AI 安全和负责任部署是最大挑战，非洲因跳过遗留问题而具备独特优势。

nando.en: AI as a tool for all humanity, emphasizing diversity, inclusion, and human skills alongside technical research.
nando.zh: 始终认为 AI 应造福全人类，强调多样性和包容性，以及技术研究中人类技能的重要性。

nando.en: From excitement about scaling and generalist agents to a focus on real-world deployment and safety in diverse contexts.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年对规模扩张和通用智能体的兴奋，转向 2026 年关注现实部署和不同背景下的安全性。

nando.en: Research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems; AI safety remains an open problem with no solutions yet.
nando.zh: 2026 年，他认为研究需要拥抱失败并简化问题，AI 安全仍是未解难题。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better data and algorithms can match larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling 可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的数据和算法，较小的模型也能媲美较大的模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training on internet data gives broad knowledge, but RLHF post-training is crucial for safe, pleasant responses.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我强调预训练提供广泛知识，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）后训练对安全、合意的回应至关重要。

yejin.en: Data is the fundamental bottleneck; current AI interpolates human knowledge, not transcends it.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我指出数据是根本瓶颈；当前 AI 只是内插人类知识，而非超越。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning can be used during pre-training to improve reasoning by rewarding information gain.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出在预训练阶段引入强化学习，通过奖励信息增益来提升推理能力。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse human values; debiasing the internet is impossible.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重人类价值观的多样性；同时认为消除互联网偏见是不可能的。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，强调设计师应会编程以建立同理心并加速交付；追求速度与熟悉感，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand strategy for startups should focus on recruiting and differentiation, not just visual identity.
henrymodisett.zh: 2024 年，认为初创公司的品牌策略应聚焦于招聘与差异化，而非仅视觉识别。

henrymodisett.en: Design is a strategic weapon; founders must articulate its role in winning, and invest early in brand.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，将设计视为战略武器，创始人需阐明其制胜作用，并尽早投资品牌。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give designers ownership and autonomy to grow.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，主张招聘多元原型而非克隆；赋予设计师所有权与自主权以促进成长。

henrymodisett.en: Avoid rigid design crits; prefer organic feedback and gut decisions over data-driven processes.
henrymodisett.zh: 2026 年，避免僵化的设计评审，偏好有机反馈与直觉决策，而非数据驱动流程。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck them; AI is a creative partner, and code is the source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 4 月，设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；AI 是创意伙伴，代码是唯一真相来源。

nadchishtie.en: Quality is like debt, paid iteratively; rapid scrappy experimentation maximizes learning.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 4 月，质量如同债务，需迭代偿还；快速粗糙的实验能最大化学习。

nadchishtie.en: Future design tools are interoperable; legacy layers panel is outdated, AI enables real progress.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 4 月，未来设计工具应互操作；传统图层面板过时，AI 带来真正进步。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; small teams outperform cross-functional squads.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月，通才型设计师用 AI 端到端执行最有价值；小团队优于跨职能大组。

nadchishtie.en: Portfolios should show craft and intentionality, not process; side projects and paid tests signal skill.
nadchishtie.zh: 2025 年 12 月，作品集应展示工艺与意图而非流程；副项目和付费测试更能体现能力。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence and solving onboarding.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文被低估了；上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能提升智能并解决上手问题。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is a new scaling axis; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI, with coding as leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是新的扩展轴；预训练加强化学习或足以实现 AGI，编码是领先指标。

sholto.en: Agent reliability over time horizon is key; longer coherence (e.g., 30 hours) expands achievements; simple RL works best.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体在时间跨度上的可靠性是关键；更长的连贯性（如 30 小时）能扩展成就；简单强化学习最有效。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means orchestration and tools matter more than raw intelligence; future work manages agent teams.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我指出能力过剩使得编排和工具比原始智能更重要；未来工作将是管理智能体团队。

sholto.en: Coding is the most tractable domain due to verifiability; AI progress is exponential and bottlenecked by compute and taste.
sholto.zh: 始终，我认为编码因可验证性而最易处理；AI 进步是指数级的，受算力和品味的制约。

truell.en: Programming shifts from text to AI-integrated environments; natural language won't be primary—examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，编程从文本编辑器转向 AI 集成环境；自然语言不会是主要方式，示例和直接操作更好。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，缩放定律预测进展；测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Agents promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 2024 年，智能体有前景但尚不实用；迭代的人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Future programming moves away from code to higher-level intent specification; taste and logic design valued over carefulness.
truell.zh: 2025 年，未来编程从代码转向更高层次的意图描述；品味和逻辑设计比细心更重要。

truell.en: Custom models essential for product quality; AI shift more consequential than internet, unfolding over decades.
truell.zh: 2025 年，定制模型对产品质量至关重要；AI 变革比互联网影响更大，将持续数十年。

leike.en: AI safety research is under-explored; empirical work and collaboration are key. Focus on skills, not capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年：AI 安全研究尚待深入，实证研究与协作是关键。应注重技能培养，而非纠结于能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight and interpretability. Alignment may be easier than thought; test empirically.
leike.zh: 2023 年：基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）无法扩展，需可扩展监督与可解释性。对齐可能比想象中容易，应实证检验。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient. External oversight and raising misuse costs are necessary.
leike.zh: 2024 年：OpenAI 安全文化受损，后训练不足以解决对齐。需外部监管并提高滥用成本。

shazeer.en: LLMs trained on next-token prediction are AI-complete; scaling compute and data improves intelligence, but inner workings remain alchemy.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，认为基于下一个词预测训练的 LLM 是 AI 完备问题；扩大算力和数据可提升智能，但内部机制仍像炼金术。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a near-term opportunity; models improve via algorithmic advances and hardware scaling, not just data.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，强调推理时算力扩展是近期机遇；模型进步依赖算法创新与硬件扩展，而非单纯数据。

shazeer.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows and modular sparse architectures for efficient scaling and specialization.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，认为未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口，并采用模块化稀疏架构以实现高效扩展与专业化。

shazeer.en: Agentic capabilities and reinforcement learning are crucial for AGI; acting in environments drives progress beyond passive data.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，强调智能体能力与强化学习对 AGI 至关重要；在环境中行动比被动数据更能推动进步。

shazeer.en: Open-source models narrow gap with frontier; AI can generate novel ideas, and coding self-accelerates AI progress.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，指出开源模型缩小与前沿差距；AI 能产生新想法，编码加速 AI 自身发展。

abbeel.en: In 2018, Abbeel saw RL plus simulation as key for robotics, but lacked hierarchy for long-horizon tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，Abbeel 认为强化学习结合仿真对机器人至关重要，但缺乏处理长时程任务的层级推理。

abbeel.en: By 2021, he advocated combining unsupervised learning with RL to boost sample efficiency, and using pretrained models for transfer.
abbeel.zh: 到 2021 年，他主张将无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率，并利用预训练模型进行迁移。

abbeel.en: Consistently, Abbeel valued self-play and imitation learning for robot skill acquisition, and warned against hard-coding prior knowledge.
abbeel.zh: 始终如一，Abbeel 重视自博弈和模仿学习在机器人技能获取中的作用，并警告不要硬编码先验知识。

abbeel.en: He shifted from pure RL to integrating unsupervised and pretrained models, while stressing real-world reliability benchmarks.
abbeel.zh: 他从纯强化学习转向整合无监督和预训练模型，同时强调现实世界的可靠性基准。

abbeel.en: He maintained that current AI is far less general than human brain, yet language models show surprising cross-domain transfer.
abbeel.zh: 他始终认为当前 AI 远不如人脑通用，但语言模型展现出惊人的跨领域迁移能力。
